questions.question: What kind of thing is Mastercard Agent Pay?
options: An open protocol governed by the FIDO Alliance
A Mastercard-branded version of Google's AP2
An IETF standard for agent payments
questions.explanation: Agent Pay is a proprietary Mastercard program with no public specification; it is not AP2.

questions.question: Which agents can receive Mastercard agentic tokens?
options: Any agent with a card number
Any agent that signs with Ed25519
questions.explanation: Mastercard says only registered agents can transact through the network.

questions.question: Which Signature-Input tag does Mastercard's Level 1 guide give for Agent Pay?
questions.explanation: The guide gives Agent-pay-auth; the browse and pay tags are Visa's.

questions.question: What is a DTVC?
options: An agentic token issued for a single merchant
A one-time code issued with a Virtual Card Token
A Verifiable Intent layer that the agent signs at checkout
An entry in the Mastercard key directory
questions.explanation: A DTVC is a one-time code issued with a Mastercard Virtual Card Token, not a token itself.

questions.question: What happens when a verifier cannot find the keyid in the directory?
questions.explanation: Mastercard's decision table blocks requests whose key is not found.

questions.question: What is the recommended lifetime of a Verifiable Intent L2 Immediate credential?
questions.explanation: The spec recommends that L2 Immediate last no more than about 15 minutes; it is a SHOULD, not a hard limit.

questions.question: In Autonomous mode, which value must L3a transaction_id equal?
options: The kid of the agent key in L2
questions.explanation: L3a transaction_id must equal L3b checkout_hash.

questions.question: How do AP2 and Verifiable Intent name the per-transaction amount constraint?
Who says AP4M will work toward MPP compatibility?
options: Visa, in its card method spec
questions.explanation: The statement is Tempo's, quoted in Mastercard's 2026-06-10 AP4M release; Mastercard's own text makes no MPP claim.

questions.question: What has Mastercard disclosed about Agent Pay volume?
options: Monthly transaction counts in earnings releases
Counts for its European issuers only
questions.explanation: No Agent Pay transaction volume or value figure was found in Mastercard's releases, its white paper or earnings coverage as of 2026-10-21.
